scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in seventeen seventy-seven... America adopted its first rulebook.

scenes.label: York, Pennsylvania
scenes.caption: Temporary home of Congress, 1777
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] With the British in Philadelphia, Congress met in York, Pennsylvania.

scenes.label: states all had to approve it
scenes.text: [calmly] There it passed the Articles of Confederation. All thirteen states had to agree... which took over three years.

scenes.label: Articles of Confederation
scenes.caption: Page one of the original
scenes.text: [softly] But Congress could not even collect taxes.

scenes.title: The Constitution took its place
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] In seventeen eighty-nine, the Constitution replaced it.
